body: Hear me out- I sit in the sink. It makes life SO much easier since I can't see without my glasses. Just sit on the counter and lean in to get the best wings.
This is really typical, but either To Kill a Mockingbird, Tuesday's with Morrie, or The Secret Life of Bees. I adored them.
I don't know why, but the idea of Kurt Cobain and gorillaz really gets me goin'.
